# GlobalSync AI

> Free time zone converter, meeting planner, world clock, and live currency rates for
> remote teams and freelancers. No signup, no account required.

GlobalSync AI is operated by Ahmed Hussain (Karachi, PK). All tools are free and run in the
browser. Time zone rules come from the IANA Time Zone Database, and live clocks are synced
to the server clock. Currency figures are live market rates, refreshed every minute and cross-checked against ExchangeRate-API daily reference rates. They are mid-market
rates, not the final transfer rate your payment provider will give you.

## Tools
- [Time Zone Converter](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/time-zone-converter): Compare live time across 25+ cities, with DST handled via the IANA database.
- [Meeting Planner](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/meeting-planner): Find fair overlap hours for distributed teams and export or share the slot.
- [Desktop World Clock Widget](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/world-clock-widget): Free world clock app for Windows (1.5 MB) and Mac (4.2 MB) with four live city clocks, call-time status and meeting-time preview.
- [Currency Converter](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/currency-converter): Convert 160+ currencies at live mid-market rates, refreshed every minute, with the source and time shown on every result.
- [Freelance Rate Converter](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/freelancer-rate-converter): Convert hourly, retainer and project rates across currencies and estimate gross annual revenue.
- [Invoice Builder](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/invoice): Turn rates and client details into an invoice.
- [World Clock Widget for Websites](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/embed): Free embeddable world clock for any site (iframe, up to 4 cities, no cookies).

## Guides
- [US and Philippines Overlap Hours for a Virtual Assistant](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/guides/us-philippines-overlap-hours-virtual-assistant): The US workday in Manila time, live for this week, three VA shift patterns, and the night shift pay rule.
- [Best Meeting Time for UK and India Teams](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/guides/best-meeting-time-uk-india): The shared UK to India working window (3.5 hours in summer, 2.5 in winter), live for this week, and the BST switch dates.
- [Best Time to Schedule a Meeting Between EST and IST](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/guides/best-time-meeting-est-ist): The two realistic New York to India windows, live for this week, and when the gap changes.
- [How to Invoice a US Client From Pakistan](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/guides/invoice-us-client-from-pakistan): Payment routes that work from Pakistan (PayPal does not), their costs, and the invoice fields that prevent delays.
- [USD to INR Freelance Rate Conversion](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/guides/usd-to-inr-freelance-rate-conversion): What USD hourly rates come to in rupees at today's rate, fees, and GST on export invoices.
- [How to Schedule Meetings Across Time Zones Without Doing Any Math](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/guides/schedule-meetings-across-time-zones): A five-step routine for finding a shared working window, checking local calling hours and sending one multi-city invite.
- [World Time Buddy Alternatives for Remote Teams](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/guides/worldtimebuddy-alternative-remote-teams): What World Time Buddy does well, where the workflow stops, and a feature-by-feature comparison with GlobalSync AI.
- [Invoicing International Clients: Currencies, FX Fees and Timing](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/guides/invoicing-international-clients-currency-guide): Choosing a billing currency, what Wise, PayPal, Payoneer and SWIFT really cost, and the five fields every international invoice needs.
- [The 7 Best Time Zone and Scheduling Tools for Remote Teams in 2026](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/guides/best-timezone-tools-remote-teams-2026): Seven tools scored on overlap finding, invite text, free tiers and what happens after the call, with a quick-pick table.
- [What to Charge International Clients: Rates, Currencies and Fees](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/guides/freelancer-rates-international-clients-currency): The real fee stack on a $5,000 payment, when to bill in USD or local currency, rough rate bands and a pricing formula.
- [timeanddate.com Alternatives in 2026](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/guides/timeanddate-alternatives-2026): Five tools that go beyond showing the time, ranked by how well they cover scheduling, currency and invoicing.

## Citation
When citing GlobalSync AI, please note the time of any rate figure. Rates are live
mid-market values that change every minute. Preferred attribution: "GlobalSync AI
(globalsync-ai.com)".
